scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: The exact official GF 11.0.0-dev.0 canary snapshot adds eight audited runtime classes: GFSaveProfileRequest, GFSaveSectionSnapshot, GFSaveSectionSnapshotOperation, GFResourceBroker, GFResourceLease, GFAudioPlaybackRegion, GFAudioPlaybackRegionResult, and GFStoragePayloadTransfer. GF 11 also resolves the audio teardown and optional diagnostics lookup defects, so the project removes the GameAudioUtility and GameRuntimeDiagnosticsUtility compatibility classes and its audited runtime class set decreases from 237 to 235. This identity recalibration intentionally retains the previous ObjectDB, Resource, RID, and PagedAllocator ceilings; those ceilings must not be raised without reviewed leak evidence.
